title: Fixing the image offset bugs.
body:
These fix the bugs in https://gitlab.com/ase/ase/-/issues/1710.

I did some minor code cleanup along the way.
author: mjwaters

comments.author: askhl
comments.body:
The GUI (from which the eps renderer was probably once copy-pasted) uses a single array of points for (presumably) efficiency and (presumably) also in order for transformations to automatically apply to all transformable coordinates.

Therefore, the main coordinate array contains positions, cell segments, bonds and quite possibly other things.

(It seems also possible for this module to organize its transformable coordinates in a way that makes bugs less likely, e.g. using a dictionary or dataclass)

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment suggests an improvement: organizing transformable coordinates using a dictionary or dataclass to make bugs less likely. This implies a concrete refactoring change.

comments.author: askhl
comments.body: Thank you very much for the fix!

thread.actionability_reasoning: This is a pure acknowledgment/social comment expressing gratitude for the fix. No code change is suggested or implied.
